title: Puzzle Plugin Residual Mop-Up (TS Assets)
description: Resolve 🧩️puzzle's leftover TS residual: 🔨️modules/🖼️assets/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript, previously measured at ~3 lines total (a stub). Investigate the actual current content and its dependents (grep for "puzzle-assets" and "puzzle/🔨️modules/🖼️assets" repo-wide). If genuinely trivial/unused, delete the module entirely and remove any stale root package.json workspace entry. If it turns out to have real, used content, fold it per Rule A into a @semio-tech/puzzle-js package at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🧩️puzzle/📦️packages/🟦️typescript/ instead, following the same Shape V2 pattern as the animate renderer fold (manifests + entry index.ts in packages dir, real source in the owner tree). Scope: ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🧩️puzzle/** only, plus minimal necessary root package.json workspace cleanup.
summary:
Investigated 🧩️puzzle's leftover TS residual at 🔨️modules/🖼️assets/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript (@semio-tech/puzzle-assets). Content was genuinely trivial: 📦️index.ts contained only a header comment ("reserved for shipped puzzle media (meshes, icons); play fixtures live under puzzle/wildcard-app/fixture/") — no real exports, no code. Repo-wide grep for "puzzle-assets" as an import found zero actual import sites in application/test source; the only live references were infrastructure wiring that pointed at the module without anything ever consuming it (root package.json workspace entry, .storybook/main.ts baseline Vite alias, and 5 sourceRoots entries across .storybook/scopes.ts's puzzle/puzzle-2d/puzzle-3d/puzzle-5d/ui scopes). Historical tickets confirm the real fixture data this module was meant to hold already lives under puzzle's play/fixture trees instead — the stub was dead weight left over from an earlier refactor, exactly matching the ~3-line measurement in the master plan.

Decision: DELETED outright (not folded into a package) since Rule A's fold applies to real, used TS modules — this had neither. Removed the whole 🔨️modules/🖼️assets tree, then removed the now-empty 🔨️modules dir itself (puzzle has no other 🔨️modules content, so an empty container dir would violate the Shape V2 tree-purity rule). Cleaned up every dangling reference: root package.json workspace entry, .storybook/main.ts's puzzle-assets alias, and all 5 sourceRoots entries in .storybook/scopes.ts (the "ui" scope's sourceRoots array also referenced it and needed the same cleanup). Also removed 4 already-stale, unrelated puzzle-rust workspace entries in root package.json (✳️apps/◻2d, 🧊️3d ⚙️engine + 🖱️ui, 🖐️5d ⚙️engine) that were blocking `bun install` with "Workspace not found" — these pointed at rust ⚡️implementations dirs that no longer exist now that puzzle's rust plugin already consolidated into 📦️packages/🦀️rust.

Verification: `bun nx show project @semio-tech/puzzle-assets` now errors (project gone, as expected). `bun nx show projects` still runs cleanly (256 projects, nx graph healthy). Repo-wide grep confirms zero remaining references to "puzzle-assets" or the old directory path anywhere outside historical ticket records and an unrelated .cursor plan doc. `bun install` no longer errors on any puzzle-related workspace entry (2 unrelated pre-existing entries for other plugins — animate-present-core and a flow bim wasm pkg — still error, out of scope, documented in the sibling animate ticket).
